propositions: The review-bot container lacks an explicit AWS region configuration (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION), causing boto3 to fail at Bedrock client construction with NoRegionError before any model call
build_bedrock_provider passes region=None to BedrockProvider when REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION is unset, forcing boto3 ambient resolution which finds no region in the container environment

boto3 region resolution uses AWS_DEFAULT_REGION (not AWS_REGION alone) and does not discover region from IMDS; IMDS reachability supplies credentials but not region, making credential access and region config independent concerns
Bedrock cutover hard-fails without fallback because pydantic-ai raises UserError (not caught by rebar's LLMError handlers) rather than a typed LLMConfigError naming the rebar setting
CloudWatch voter metrics in review-bot silently no-op due to the same missing-region root cause, breaking eb6e's rollback alarm dependency

Pre-flight validation must check boto3.session.Session().region_name before provider construction and raise typed LLMConfigError with the rebar setting name, not rely on env sniffing or bare boto3 exceptions
